info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchant Relations Management API
info.description: The Merchant Relations Management API facilitates dynamic updates to merchant relationships, enabling businesses to adapt and enhance their interactions with partners. This API allows authorized users to modify key relationship attributes, ensuring that partnership agreements are current and reflective of business needs. Typical consumers include merchant account managers and business development teams who require seamless adjustments to merchant profiles. With this API, organizations can maintain strong partnerships, optimize merchant services, and respond quickly to market changes.

patch.summary: Update Merchant Relation for a Card
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the merchant relation associated with a specific card by providing the necessary details in the request body. Ensure you have the correct permissions to modify merchant relations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update merchant relations for the specified card. Please provide the necessary attributes in JSON format to ensure accurate updates.
